page.layout: One page of verse, single column of text; faint printed marginal notes at the right edge (not legible enough to transcribe); handwritten annotations in the left margin and bottom (not printed text, described under notes).

main_text.p:
At lolium si des infelix forte molendum,
Effluet infelix trita farina tibi.

Hinc animi speciem non tardus dispice nostri,
Absque quiete labor quem mouet assiduus.

Vtile versandum si quid des, vtilis inde,
Qui late, fructus, percipietur, erit.

At mala si menti male sanæ sensa ministres,
Illinc prodibit perniciosa lues.
main_text.head: Artemisia herba. Coniugalis amor.
main_text.p:
Fœmineis soleo morbis succurrere: nomen
Inde suum nobis Artemisia dedit:
Quæ viuum tanto dilexit amore maritum:
Defuncti cineres huius vt ebiberit.
Qui me cunque vides, reginæ nomen & audis:
Dic, quàm multa potest connubialis amor!
main_text.head: Lamium innocens herba, apud Plinium.
main_text.p:
A reliquis, reliqui desumant symbola, plantis:
Vt pingant animi signa notata sui.
Stirps placet vna mihi Lamij: quæ continet orbem
Virtutum, dum non dicitur esse nocens.
main_text.head: Non nocere & prodesse.
main_text.p:
Esse nocens Lamium non vllus dixerit, atqui
Hæc minime laus est vltima, prima licet.
Nam male qui nullis, bene sed facit omnibus, illi
Obtingit summus laudis in arce locus.
Hinc Lamium nocuum nullis, ast vtile multis,
Indolis opto sit vt tessera certa meæ.

page.notes: Handwritten annotations in the left margin and at the foot (Latin and marginal remarks in a later hand) are not printed text and are omitted. Marginal printed notes at the right are too faint to read and are not transcribed. Catchword and signature absent.
